name: Skills
summary: Inline Foundry Skills packaged into a Toolbox and delivered to a BYOM-routed agent via MCP.
description: `project.beta.skills.create(...)` creates a Foundry Skill that should later be versioned and exposed to agents through Toolbox/MCP. This would let users package reusable tool logic while a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent invokes the skill-backed toolbox.
notes:
Not yet validated end-to-end because the Skill service is blocked by a service-side versioning bug. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai/foundry/agents/how-to/tools/skills. See `test.py`.

Observed live on 2026-07-15 in westus3 with `azure-ai-projects 2.3.0` following the official sample: `project.beta.skills.create(...)` returns HTTP 202, then the SDK poller hits `Skill is in state 'Creating' and cannot accept new versions`. The parent Skill reports `default_version='1'`, but `get_version(name, '1')` returns 404, `list_versions()` returns `[]`, and the Foundry portal cannot open repro skill `byomprobec1f434a1`. Reference sample: https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-python/blob/main/sdk/ai/azure-ai-projects/samples/agents/tools/sample_agent_toolbox_skill.py.
